description: Header file defining the gl::Renderbuffer class and related classes for OpenGL ES renderbuffer objects, including state management and interface methods.

classes.name: RenderbufferState
classes.description: Manages the state of a renderbuffer, including size, format, samples, and initialization state.

classes.name: Renderbuffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL ES renderbuffer object, providing methods for storage management, labeling, and attachment handling.

methods.name: RenderbufferState
methods.description: Constructor for RenderbufferState.

methods.name: ~RenderbufferState
methods.description: Destructor for RenderbufferState.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for multisampling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the renderbuffer state with new size, format, samples, and init state.

methods.name: Renderbuffer
methods.description: Constructor for Renderbuffer, initializes with implementation factory and ID.

methods.name: ~Renderbuffer
methods.description: Destructor for Renderbuffer.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the renderbuffer is destroyed.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Allocates storage for the renderbuffer with specified internal format and size.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Allocates multisample storage for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorageEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Sets storage from an EGL image.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the implementation-specific renderbuffer object.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples.

methods.name: getRedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the red component.

methods.name: getGreenSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the green component.

methods.name: getBlueSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the blue component.

methods.name: getAlphaSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the alpha component.

methods.name: getDepthSize
methods.description: Returns the depth component size.

methods.name: getStencilSize
methods.description: Returns the stencil component size.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getAttachmentSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment at a given image index.

methods.name: getAttachmentFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachmentSamples
methods.description: Returns the sample count of the attachment.

methods.name: isRenderable
methods.description: Checks if the renderbuffer is renderable in the given context and binding.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Handles actions when the renderbuffer is attached.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Handles actions when the renderbuffer is detached.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Returns the initialization state of the renderbuffer at a given image index.

methods.name: setInitState
methods.description: Sets the initialization state for a given image index.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the color read format for the implementation.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the color read type for the implementation.

methods.name: getRenderbufferImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image data from the renderbuffer.
